title: Missing axonmyelin mask with 3-class models (#1003)
prompt:
Bug report: when I segment images with a model that has 3 output classes (axon, myelin and
unmyelinated axon), the combined `<image>_seg-axonmyelin.png` mask is never written. With the
usual 2-class models (axon + myelin) it is. The axon and myelin masks themselves are saved fine.
This breaks `axondeepseg_morphometrics`, which needs the axonmyelin mask to overlay the index numbers.

Find the root cause, explain it briefly, and fix it with a minimal change.
final_answer:
**Root cause:** in `AxonDeepSeg/apply_model.py` (`axon_segmentation`), the merge was gated on an exact list match: `['axon', 'myelin'] == output_classes`. A 3-class model gives `['axon', 'myelin', 'unmyelinated axon']`, so the check was False and `merge_masks` never ran. The per-class masks were still written by the loop above it, which is why those looked fine.

**Fix:**
- The check is now a subset test: `{'axon', 'myelin'} <= set(output_classes)`.
- The merge picks the axon and myelin masks by class name instead of `new_masks[0]` and `new_masks[1]`, so it no longer depends on sort order.

I haven't run the tests or a 3-class model. I also didn't check that `merge_masks` ignores the extra class, since it only receives the axon and myelin paths.
diff:
diff --git a/AxonDeepSeg/apply_model.py b/AxonDeepSeg/apply_model.py
index 0aeabd1..a60a975 100644
--- a/AxonDeepSeg/apply_model.py
+++ b/AxonDeepSeg/apply_model.py
@@ -209,7 +209,7 @@ def axon_segmentation(
     output_structure = predictor.dataset_json['labels']
     output_classes = sorted(list(output_structure.keys()))
     output_classes.remove('background')
-    is_axonmyelin_seg = ['axon', 'myelin'] == output_classes
+    is_axonmyelin_seg = {'axon', 'myelin'} <= set(output_classes)
 
     # nnUNet outputs a single file will all classes mapped to consecutive ints
     for pred_path in output_list:
@@ -224,6 +224,9 @@ def axon_segmentation(
         logger.info(f'Successfully saved masks for classes: {output_classes}.')
 
         if is_axonmyelin_seg:
-            merge_masks(new_masks[0], new_masks[1])
+            merge_masks(
+                new_masks[output_classes.index('axon')],
+                new_masks[output_classes.index('myelin')],
+            )
 
         Path(fname).unlink()
